# SyndeoCare

SyndeoCare is a bilingual Arabic and English healthcare staffing platform for Yemen. It connects verified healthcare professionals with clinics and medical facilities for shifts, staffing, applications, bookings, document verification, notifications, and secure messaging.

## Public information

- Home: https://syndeocare.ai/
- For healthcare professionals: https://syndeocare.ai/for-professionals
- For clinics and medical facilities: https://syndeocare.ai/for-clinics
- About: https://syndeocare.ai/about
- Help: https://syndeocare.ai/help
- Privacy: https://syndeocare.ai/privacy
- Terms: https://syndeocare.ai/terms

## Arabic summary

سنديوكير منصة توظيف صحي وورديات طبية في اليمن، تربط المنشآت الصحية بالمختصين الصحيين الموثقين وتدعم إدارة الوظائف والطلبات والحجوزات والتوثيق والرسائل.

Private account, dashboard, profile, document, and message pages must not be indexed or treated as public sources.
